title: French Chicken Stir Fry
description: A classic French-inspired stir fry dish with a twist, using chicken and paleo-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and the paleo stir-fry sauce.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with scallions.
Serve with additional paleo stir-fry sauce on the side, if desired.
